_doc: Hang bound for every quality-gate command run through gzkit.quality.run_command (GHI #1143). A command that exceeds it has its whole process tree killed and fails closed with exit 124, so a deadlocked child (e.g. a unittest-parallel worker) cannot hold gz check or the pre-push hook open silently. This is a hang bound, NOT a performance budget: it must sit well above the slowest healthy step. Measured 2026-09-27 (a dated record) on one developer host: full unit suite 86.3 s, slowest measured gz check step ~32 s; the bound was first set to 900 from that. Re-measured 2026-10-04 (a dated record) over the twelve most recent CI runs: a healthy unit tier took 274 to 401 s on ubuntu-latest and 696 to 895 s on windows-latest, and three windows-latest runs were killed at 900 s with no failing test. Raised to 1800, about twice the slowest healthy run, on the operator's ruling (GHI #1165). Raise default_seconds only with a new measurement.
